_meta: Curated activities with starting loadout guidance, seeded from knowledge as of early 2026. Newer (2026) raids/seasons are NOT here — add them in-app. Champion types and burns rotate; VERIFY against the current rotation. Every field is editable.

activities.name: Salvation's Edge (Raid)
activities.weapons: Well of Radiance support; high single-target DPS heavy (LFR/rocket). Microcosm/Still Hunt strong.
activities.notes: Coordination-heavy; bring strong burst DPS and a survivability build. Final Shape raid.

activities.name: Crota's End (Raid)
activities.weapons: Sword for Crota damage; add-clear primary; Tractor Cannon for debuff.
activities.notes: Banner of War Titan excels. Swords shine on the boss.

activities.name: Root of Nightmares (Raid)
activities.weapons: Linear Fusions for Nezarec/Macrocosm; Well support.
activities.notes: DPS check on final boss — stack damage and Well.

activities.name: Last Wish (Raid)
activities.weapons: Riven cheese or legit DPS; Tractor Cannon; high-DPS heavy.
activities.notes: Oldest raid; mechanics-heavy. Divinity helps the team.

activities.name: Vault of Glass (Raid)
activities.weapons: Atheon DPS: rockets/LFRs; relic on Templar.
activities.notes: Beginner-friendly raid; bring add-clear and burst DPS.

activities.name: Deep Stone Crypt (Raid)
activities.weapons: Taniks DPS rockets/LFRs; Heritage shotgun classic.
activities.notes: Operator/Scanner roles; survivability for the final encounter.

activities.name: King's Fall (Raid)
activities.weapons: Touch of Malice; high DPS for Oryx; Well.
activities.notes: Totems/relics; strong burst for Oryx damage.

activities.name: Garden of Salvation (Raid)
activities.notes: Tether/relay mechanics; Divinity very strong here.

activities.name: Grandmaster Nightfall
activities.weapons: Anti-champion (check weekly mods); survivability + ranged primary; Tractor/Div for boss.
activities.notes: Match anti-Champion mods to the weekly Overload/Unstoppable/Barrier. Invis Hunter or Well Warlock for safety. Respect the burn.

activities.name: Legend/Master Lost Sector
activities.weapons: Anti-champion match; high single-target for the boss.
activities.notes: Solo for exotic armor. Match champions + shield elements; survivability build.

activities.name: The Final Shape (Campaign)
activities.notes: Prismatic unlocks here; Legendary difficulty rewards good gear.

activities.name: Lightfall (Campaign)
activities.notes: Legendary campaign is tough solo — survivability matters.

activities.name: The Witch Queen (Campaign)
activities.notes: Strong story + Legendary difficulty for upgraded rewards.
